lens: Product systems and reliability; keyboard-oriented use (simulated AI expertise/user lens)
reason: The public proposition and Precision Instrument hierarchy are clear in source and the supplied desktop hero capture. I traced the student journey from Join preparation and evaluation criteria through Apply, recovery selection, materials and submission. Recovery pauses writes, compares copies, moves keyboard focus to the decision heading, and discloses tab-limited recovery. Original-PDF reviewer access is explicitly disclosed rather than called anonymous. Round closure clearly distinguishes submitted from valid independent evidence, warns about irreversible locking, initially focuses cancellation and restores trigger focus on Escape. However, its uncertain-write state can falsely imply grading remains open after it has closed. That gap prevents world-class agreement and warrants holding this operator change for correction. This is an independent AI source/capture assessment, not observed user success or hosted acceptance.

findings.evidence: useRushAction.act catches a rejected POST as “Request failed”, returns false and clears pending without refreshing or reconciling. saveStatus therefore leaves confirmation and its ready snapshot intact. The dialog then re-enables “Keep grading open” and “Close grading and lock submissions”. If set_round_status committed before transport failure, cancellation only dismisses the dialog; it cannot keep grading open. authorizedFetch in src/lib/client-fetch.ts only retries 401 and does not reconcile writes. tests/e2e/operator-close.spec.ts:85-92 aborts the GET coverage request, leaving this POST uncertainty untested. This is a source-derived failure path, not a reproduced hosted incident.
findings.userImpact: A keyboard operator can dismiss the alert with the reassuring cancellation action and believe unfinished evaluations remain writable, although the irreversible freeze may already have happened.
findings.suggestedFix: Model an unknown close outcome, announce it, and read authoritative round status before offering further close/cancel claims. Confirm a frozen result explicitly; if reconciliation is unavailable, require checking current status and label dismissal “Close dialog”. Add a targeted lost-response-after-commit test including focus and announcement behavior.

notVerified: No staging, deployment, real-user study or live authenticated journey exists in this evidence. Clerk session expiry, Supabase RPC/RLS, storage transitions and email delivery remain unverified together.
Supplied 18-case operator log proves synthetic coverage/confirmation cases; the two-session draft result proves its initial-save race only. Neither proves all concurrency or uncertain-close outcomes.
No browser or test suite was run for this seat. Full keyboard traversal, assistive-technology announcements, physical devices, Safari and Firefox remain unobserved.

The operator mobile capture is synthetic; private recovery and release visual craft was assessed from source, not authenticated screenshots. Board resume policy approval, client publication approval and migration/application rollout remain external dependencies.
